description:
We are seeking a Software Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of modern enterprise applications. This role is best suited for a versatile full-stack developer with strong experience in web application development, AWS-hosted systems, and enterprise platforms. The selected candidate will contribute to architecture, implementation, troubleshooting, and technical mentorship across a diverse technology stack.

 Primary Responsibilities: 

 The selected candidate’s key responsibilities are the following:
 Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable full-stack applications
 Develop backend services and microservices using modern frameworks and API best practices
 Build responsive, maintainable frontend applications using Angular
 Deploy, support, and troubleshoot applications in AWS environments
 Implement infrastructure as code for repeatable provisioning and configuration
 Develop and improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows
 Write clean, testable, well-documented code with strong unit and integration coverage
 Review code and provide actionable technical feedback
 Mentor junior developers
 Troubleshoot production issues across application, system, and infrastructure layers
 Participate in architecture discussions, technical planning, and design decisions 
 Evaluate technologies and recommend practical improvements to tools, systems, and processes
 
 Basic Qualifications 
 Must have an active TS/SCI with Poly
 Must have at least 8 years of experience with a Bachelor's degree OR Masters and at least 6 years experience.
 Production experience with Node.js/NestJS
 Strong frontend development experience with Angular
 Experience deploying and supporting applications in AWS including hands on experience with EC2, S3, RDS, and CloudWatch
 Experience implementing infrastructure as code using tools such as CloudFormation, Terraform, or AWS CDK
 Strong Linux administration and scripting skills
 Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows
 Strong understanding of API design, microservices, and modern software engineering practices
 Ability to work within enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow, SharePoint, or WordPress when required
 Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills
 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Understanding of secure development practices and OWASP guidance
 Experience with Docker and Kubernetes Knowledge of relational databases such as MySQL; familiarity with MongoDB is a plus1
 Experience with additional AWS services such as Lambda
 Experience with logging and monitoring tools such as the ELK Stack
 Familiarity with messaging or event-driven systems such as SQS, RabbitMQ, or Kafka
 Experience with Java and Spring Boot
 Experience with ServiceNow, SharePoint, or WordPress in enterprise environments
 
 #MSBA
 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

November 20, 2026 
 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.

Pay Range $92,300.00 - $166,850.00

Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.
